spacing.$description: Spacing: --spacing is the step of the numeric utilities (p-400 is 400 times it, 16px); none to 4xl are named steps of the size scale; phrase, prose, text and title are line lengths in ch.

size.$description: The primitive length scale that spacing, container, border and radius name: size.100 is 4px, size.400 is 16px. The CSS publishes the resolved values, not these.

radius.$description: Corner radii in two scales, round and squircle-* (about 1.7 times larger for the same visual corner): UI code uses --magma-radius-*, which picks the scale of the active corner shape.

font.$description: The four font families, used through the typography styles: title (Roboto), info (Karla), read (Merriweather), code (Roboto Mono).

palette.$description: The colour primitives the semantic roles are built from: they follow the light and dark mode, not the named themes or the contrast preference. Each ramp runs from 01, the most contrast against the page, to 10, the closest to it.

surface.$description: Background ladders by elevation (sunken, muted, default, raised, overlay), one per family: the neutral ones are behind the surface roles of each theme, no role uses the status ones today.

neutral.$description: The surface ladder of the neutral family.

variant.$description: The ramps behind the accents, each an alias of a brand or label ramp, step by step.

primary.$description: The brand accent ramp behind magma.accent: an alias of brand.maggioli.

brand.$description: The Maggioli brand palettes, for brand identity such as logo containers and brand panels: UI code may paint with them directly.

maggioli.$description: The Maggioli brand colour, also the brand accent of the interface.

label.$description: Twelve categorical hues for colour that encodes data, such as a category, a tag or a colour picked by the person: UI code may paint with them directly.

sky.$description: The sky hue of the categorical palette.

status.$description: The status ramps behind the status roles (magma.info, magma.success, magma.warning, magma.danger); the bare family name is its key colour.

error.$description: The error ramp, behind the danger roles: errors and destructive actions.

tone.$description: Neutral ramps behind the neutral roles and the named themes: paint with the roles, not with these. seed is the pure extreme of the mode, white in light and black in dark, for a knockout.

neutral.$description: The grey ramp behind the neutral roles of the default theme.

border.$description: Border ladders (muted, default, strong), one per neutral and status family: the primitives behind the border roles.

error.$description: The border ladder of the error family.

neutral.$description: The border ladder of the neutral family.

text.$description: Text ladders (default, muted, subtle, disabled), one per neutral and status family, solved for contrast: the primitives behind the text roles.

error.$description: The text ladder of the error family.

neutral.$description: The text ladder of the neutral family.

magma.$description: The semantic layer: the roles UI code paints with, which follow the mode, the named theme and the contrast preference.

ink.$description: The colour of a projected shadow, to compose with your own geometry and alpha.

tint.$description: Internal pointers of the active theme: not an API, never read outside this layer.

accent.$description: The brand accent: actions and selection.

surface.$description: A background tinted with the brand accent: a selected row or chip.

fg.$description: Text or an icon in the brand accent on a neutral surface, such as a link.

border.$description: A border tinted with the brand accent.

emphasis.$description: The solid fill of the brand accent: the primary action.

emphasis-hover.$description: The solid fill of the brand accent, hovered.

emphasis-active.$description: The solid fill of the brand accent, pressed.

surface-hover.$description: A background tinted with the brand accent, hovered.

surface-subtle.$description: A background tinted with the brand accent, lighter.

on-emphasis.$description: Text and icons on the solid fill of the brand accent.

danger.$description: The danger status (errors, destructive actions): backgrounds, text, borders and fills.

wash-soft.$description: The danger background, the least marked.

wash-base.$description: The danger background, at its default prominence.

wash-strong.$description: The danger background, the most marked: icons only, no essential text.

text-default.$description: Danger text on the danger background.

text-muted.$description: Secondary danger text on the danger background.

text-subtle.$description: Non-essential danger text on the danger background.

text-disabled.$description: Disabled danger text on the danger background.

border-strong.$description: The danger border that conveys a state.

emphasis.$description: The solid danger fill: a solid badge, a button.

on-emphasis.$description: Text and icons on the solid danger fill.

surface.$description: Shortcut for the danger background at its default prominence (wash-base).

fg.$description: Shortcut for the default danger text (text-default).

border.$description: Shortcut for the functional danger border (border-default).

wash.$description: Neutral pills and chips, by how marked they are.

soft.$description: A neutral pill or chip, the least marked.

base.$description: A neutral pill or chip, at its default prominence.

strong.$description: A neutral pill or chip, the most marked.

border.$description: Borders, by prominence, and the focus ring.

muted.$description: Decorative borders: dividers, the grid of a table.

strong.$description: A border that conveys a state, such as selected.

default.$description: Body text, titles and primary data.

muted.$description: Secondary text that is still essential, such as an address or a phone number.

subtle.$description: Non-essential text only: captions, units, hints.

on-emphasis.$description: Text and icons on a solid fill.

surface.$description: The backgrounds of the page by elevation, and the inverse chip.

sunken.$description: Below the page: wells, insets, code blocks, tracks.

muted.$description: Same-plane grouping on the page: zebra rows, a subtle section.

default.$description: The page canvas, the background of the body.

raised.$description: Above the page: cards, panels, sticky headers.

overlay.$description: Floating above everything: modal, dropdown, popover, sheet.

inverse.$description: A chip that flips with the mode: dark on a light page, light on a dark one.

inverse-muted.$description: The inverse chip, one step quieter.

shadow.$description: Box shadows: xs to 2xl by elevation (the -sharp ones add a 1px contact edge), inset-* for recessed wells, the glow, box, outline and highlight composites, and ring-*, borders drawn with box-shadow in the neutral ink, which follow the mode.

ease.$description: Easing curves by family, sine to expo plus back, which overshoots: in- accelerates (exits), out- decelerates (entrances), in-out- moves within the view.

duration.$description: Durations for transitions and animations, named by their length in milliseconds.

aspect.$description: Aspect ratios for media and frames, width over height: book is an alias of a4.

text-size.$description: The parts of each typography style as custom properties: set text with the whole style (typography), not by composing its parts.

title.$description: The parts of the title styles.

h1.$description: The size of the title h1 style, with its weight, letter spacing and line height.

typography.$description: Text styles as one unit (family, size, weight, letter spacing, line height): set UI text with them, through the text-* utilities or the typography-* classes.

title.$description: Roboto styles for headings and actions.

h1.$description: The largest heading: the title of a page.
